reviews.text:
Amazing people work here.

Marija was very thorough, helpful and empathetic. Getting my taxes done was a breeze. They go out of there way for a client here. Beats doing the taxes yourself, treat yourself to a great service with these people that have fair / excellent pricing and thorough tax checks. Been with them 2024 and 2025 so far so great.

Thanks much, John C.

Marija has been a huge asset to our short term rental business and able to save us with her vast knowledge in the area. She has been doing our bookkeeping for that as well as personal taxes. She makes it easy to understand and is reasonable.

Thanks again!
Marija is the best!! She is professional, thorough, and a joy to work with. She is also very patient and helpful. She has been doing our taxes for a few years and does a great job!
I worked with Marija - she really knows her stuff and took the time to answer my questions!!   E&N Tax experience was great.

Marija is amazing. I’ve recommended her to friends and family because she’s reliable, knowledgeable, and always goes the extra mile. She makes something that can be so stressful much easier to handle. If you need a great tax accountant, Marija is the one to call.

“E & N delivers excellent tax preparation and tax strategy guidance. Professional, reliable, and truly focused on helping clients keep more of what they earn. I started using their services in 2023 and it has been second to none!”
I've never had a tax preparer who was this attentive and thorough. Marija gives you her full attention, answers every question, and clearly loves what she does. Highly recommend.
If you need help with your taxes Marija is the person to go with. She has been doing my taxes for years I can’t explain how helpful she is. Always explaining everything and answering all my questions

Marija has been handling my taxes for several years, and I can’t recommend her highly enough. She is extremely knowledgeable, detail-oriented, and consistently makes the entire process easy and stress-free. Her professionalism, responsiveness, and genuine care for her clients truly set her apart. I completely trust her with my taxes and wouldn’t go anywhere else. If you’re looking for someone exceptional, Marija is the one!
